title: Audio Scene Editing V1.0

Identifier.AIMName: /* The name of the AIM, given by the concatenation of the two strings ImplementerID and ImplementationID, in this order, with no space and no character between them. */

Description: Audio Scene Editing. One Audio Scene is open at a time, so a User Command need not name it: a Audio Scene arriving is opened, and the first Object added to no open Scene creates one. The User Command places Audio Objects - named as the User names them - (AddedObjects), moves them (MovedObjects), changes where they are (ChangedObjects), takes them out (RemovedObjects) and sets where the Scene is heard from (UserPoV). Every edit is a new version in Shared Storage. Outputs: the open Audio Scene, and the User Command, with its response (UserCommandRS) saying how each action was executed.
